categories.main_business_segments: HEROZ operates two main business segments: the AI/DX business and the AI Security business. The AI/DX segment covers both B2C (notably the Shogi Wars app and related services) and B2B (AI solutions, SaaS integration, and enterprise AI tools) offerings, including group companies such as Strategit, AIsquare, Tifana Dot Com, and VOIQ. The AI Security segment is centered on managed security and integration services provided by subsidiary VarioSecure, focusing on network and endpoint security for enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, including machine learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning, originally developed for board game AI (notably shogi). These technologies are now applied to SaaS, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and security solutions. HEROZ emphasizes proprietary AI agent architectures, continuous machine learning from industry-specific data, and integration of AI with SaaS and security platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HEROZ serves a diverse customer base: B2C users are primarily individual consumers of its shogi-related apps and e-learning services, while B2B clients include enterprises in finance, construction, entertainment, contact centers, public sector, and SMEs seeking AI, SaaS, and security solutions. Key markets include companies seeking digital transformation (DX), SaaS integration, and managed security services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Japan, with all major subsidiaries and the majority of customers located domestically. Its B2C apps are available globally via app stores, but over 90% of consolidated sales are from Japan. VarioSecure’s managed security services cover all 47 prefectures in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: HEROZ operates downstream in the supply chain, delivering end-user applications, SaaS, and managed services directly to consumers and enterprise clients. In security, it provides integrated solutions including hardware, software, and ongoing management, often via indirect sales through partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, HEROZ is focused on accelerating AI transformation (AIX) across industries, with a strong emphasis on developing next-generation autonomous AI agents (AI Agent2.0/Meta Agent) and expanding its AI BPaaS (Business Process as a Service) model. R&D priorities include generative AI, LLMs, SaaS integration, security technologies, and the practical implementation of AI agents in business workflows. The group also pursues M&A to strengthen its technology and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of models: B2C app sales rely on in-app purchases and subscriptions (e.g., Shogi Wars), while B2B services use a combination of initial setup fees and recurring monthly fees for AI/SaaS solutions, and monthly recurring revenue for managed security services. The group emphasizes a shift toward stock-type (recurring) business models, especially in SaaS and security.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HEROZ faces competition from global and domestic AI, SaaS, and security vendors, including large IT companies and specialized startups. In B2C shogi AI, it holds a dominant position in Japan. In B2B AI/SaaS and security, it competes with both established IT service providers and new entrants leveraging generative AI and LLMs. The company positions itself as an innovator in AI agent technology and integrated BPaaS solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending April 2025, HEROZ reported consolidated sales of approximately 5.93 billion yen (up 22.5% YoY), with 294 employees. The AI/DX segment grew significantly, while AI Security remained stable. Despite revenue growth, the company posted a net loss of 177 million yen, though losses narrowed from the previous year. The company is in a growth phase, investing in R&D and M&A, with a focus on expanding recurring revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HEROZ differentiates itself through proprietary AI agent technology, deep expertise in machine learning and LLMs, and the ability to deliver integrated, autonomous AI-driven business process solutions (AI BPaaS). Its unique value lies in combining advanced AI with SaaS and security, offering both consumer-facing and enterprise-grade solutions that automate and optimize complex workflows. The company emphasizes innovation, scalability, and the practical realization of AI transformation for clients.
